contracts.declarative.ResourceMetadata.description:
Common metadata for all declarative resources.

# Fields

- `name`: Resource local identifier (resolver input for identity mapping)
- `description`: Human-readable description
- `tags`: Key-value pairs for filtering and organization
- `annotations`: Key-value pairs for extended metadata (not used for filtering)
- `providerRef`: The Provider the resource is filed under

name.description:
Resource name.

This is a service-scoped local identifier used by declarative identity mapping.
The final TRN resource path is resolver-derived and may compose additional
namespace context. Workspace filename matching, if required, is a loader/workspace
policy and not a contracts-level invariant.

tags.description:
Tags for filtering and organization.

Tags are key-value pairs that can be used for:
- Filtering resources in queries
- Organizing resources by environment, team, etc.

annotations.description:
Annotations for extended metadata.

Unlike tags, annotations are not used for filtering.
They're meant for storing additional metadata like:
- Creation tool information
- External system references
- Custom metadata

providerRef.description:
The Provider this resource is filed under, as a ProviderHub Provider
TRN of the resource's own tenant.

It only files the resource for filtering and display; it never
changes how the resource runs. A Provider resource carries none.

contracts.declarative.ResourceTrn.description:
A validated literal TRN reference — the final scalar value of every
declarative reference field.

contracts.declarative.McpEndpointSpec.description:
Exposes the operations it lists to external MCP clients.

An MCP exchange has neither a workspace nor an approval workflow, so a tool
here is only an operation reference. Every tool call runs as
`serviceAccountRef`; the caller's own credential only decides whether it
may enter the endpoint.

tools.description: Operations this endpoint lists and executes.

serviceAccountRef.description:
Runtime identity every tool call executes as. Permissions attach to
this ServiceAccount through Auth policies, not here.

contracts.core.OperationReference.description:
One original operation, its optional concrete resource binding and, for
an operation that calls through a caller-selected connection, that
connection. The operation identity is never inferred from the resource's
service or kind.

connectionRef.description:
The connection the call goes through, exactly when the operation's
call binding declares one. A connection is current state: its TRN
never carries a version qualifier.

contracts.core.OperationId.description: Typed operation identifier (`namespace.subject.action`) validated at construction.
